Ku(kū)cu(ci)māra
a. ancient writer on Kāmaśāstra; the ‘aupaniṣadika-prayogas’ are ascribed to him. See Vātsyāyana's K. s., I. i. 17 an. his list of 64 Kalās, 21st called ‘Kaucumārāśca yogāh2’; Rājaśekhara's K. m. GOS. I. p. 1. an. Somadeva's Yaśastilakacampū (K. M. [Page173-b] 70. Vol. II. p. 246; see V. Raghavan, J. of the G. Jha. Res. Inst. I. iv. 1944. p.. 472-3).
